```turtle
@prefix fis:  <http://example.org/onto/securities#> .
@prefix owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

#################################################################
# Ontology header
#################################################################

<http://example.org/onto/securities> a owl:Ontology ;
  rdfs:comment "An ontology of securities, financial instruments, bonds, equities, derivatives and investment funds, built from a corpus of descriptive and standard-setting texts (incl. US/UK regulatory text, ECB glossary, IAS 32/IFRS 9, FINRA, CFI, BIS, OpenStax)." .

#################################################################
# 1. TOP-LEVEL: FinancialInstrument / CashInstrument / DerivativeInstrument
#################################################################

fis:FinancialInstrument a owl:Class ;
  rdfs:label "financial instrument" ;
  rdfs:comment "A monetary contract between parties that gives rise to a financial asset of one entity and a financial liability or equity instrument of another entity (IAS 32)." .

fis:CashInstrument a owl:Class ;
  rdfs:subClassOf fis:FinancialInstrument ;
  rdfs:comment "An instrument whose value is determined directly by the markets (e.g. securities, loans, deposits)." .

fis:DerivativeInstrument a owl:Class ;
  rdfs:label "derivative" ;
  rdfs:subClassOf fis:FinancialInstrument ;
  owl:equivalentClass [
    a owl:Class ;
    owl:intersectionOf ( fis:FinancialInstrument
                          [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasUnderlying ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:Underlier ] )
  ] ;
  rdfs:comment "A financial contract whose value is derived from the performance of one or more underlying assets, rates, indices or events. NOTE: the US SEC/statutory definition of 'security' also lists derivatives as a category of security; this ontology instead follows the cash-instrument/derivative-instrument split used by ECB/CFI/BIS sources, and records the conflict here." .

owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:CashInstrument fis:DerivativeInstrument ) ] .

fis:Underlier a owl:Class ;
  rdfs:comment "Something on which a derivative's value is based: a commodity, a financial instrument, a price index, a currency, or an interest rate." .
fis:Commodity a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Underlier .
fis:MarketIndex a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Underlier .
fis:Currency a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Underlier .
fis:InterestRate a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Underlier .
fis:FinancialInstrument rdfs:subClassOf fis:Underlier .

owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:Commodity fis:MarketIndex fis:Currency fis:InterestRate fis:FinancialInstrument ) ] .

fis:CreditEvent a owl:Class ;
  rdfs:comment "An event, such as default, that triggers payment under a credit derivative." .

#################################################################
# 2. SECURITY
#################################################################

fis:Security a owl:Class ;
  rdfs:subClassOf fis:CashInstrument ;
  owl:equivalentClass [
    a owl:Class ;
    owl:intersectionOf ( fis:CashInstrument
                          [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:isTradable ; owl:hasValue true ] )
  ] ;
  rdfs:comment "A tradable financial asset; a financial contract entitling the holder to investment returns, enforceable by the holder against the issuer." .

fis:Loan a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:CashInstrument ; owl:disjointWith fis:Security ;
  rdfs:comment "A cash instrument requiring agreement between borrower and lender to transfer; not readily transferable, hence not a security." .
fis:Deposit a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:CashInstrument ; owl:disjointWith fis:Security .

fis:ClaimType a owl:Class ; rdfs:comment "The nature of the claim a security holder has on the issuer." .
fis:CreditorClaim a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:ClaimType .
fis:OwnershipClaim a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:ClaimType .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:CreditorClaim fis:OwnershipClaim ) ] .

fis:DebtSecurity a owl:Class ;
  rdfs:label "debt security" ; rdfs:label "fixed income security" ;
  owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Security
      [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasClaimType ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:CreditorClaim ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "A security under which the issuer owes the holder a debt and is obliged to repay principal and, usually, pay interest." .

fis:EquitySecurity a owl:Class ;
  rdfs:label "equity" ;
  owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Security
      [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasClaimType ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:OwnershipClaim ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "A share of equity interest in an entity such as the capital stock of a company, trust or partnership; a residual claim after creditors are paid." .

owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:DebtSecurity fis:EquitySecurity ) ] .

fis:HybridSecurity a owl:Class ;
  rdfs:subClassOf fis:Security ;
  rdfs:comment "A security combining characteristics of both debt and equity securities (e.g. preferred stock, convertible bonds, equity warrants). Not disjoint from DebtSecurity or EquitySecurity." .

fis:FungibleSecurity a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Security
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:isFungible ; owl:hasValue true ] ) ] .
fis:NonFungibleSecurity a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Security
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:isFungible ; owl:hasValue false ] ) ] .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:FungibleSecurity fis:NonFungibleSecurity ) ] .

fis:OwnershipRecordType a owl:Class .
fis:BearerForm a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:OwnershipRecordType .
fis:RegisteredForm a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:OwnershipRecordType .
fis:BookEntryForm a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:OwnershipRecordType .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:BearerForm fis:RegisteredForm fis:BookEntryForm ) ] .

fis:BearerSecurity a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Security
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasOwnershipRecordType ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:BearerForm ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "Entitles the holder to rights merely by possession; transferred by delivery." .
fis:RegisteredSecurity a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Security
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasOwnershipRecordType ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:RegisteredForm ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "Entitles the holder to rights only if registered on a security register maintained by the issuer or an intermediary." .
fis:BookEntrySecurity a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Security
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasOwnershipRecordType ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:BookEntryForm ] ) ] .

#################################################################
# 3. ISSUERS AND HOLDERS
#################################################################

fis:Issuer a owl:Class ; rdfs:comment "The entity which is obligated on a security or other financial instrument." .
fis:SovereignGovernment a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Issuer .
fis:MunicipalGovernment a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Issuer .
fis:SupranationalOrganization a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Issuer .
fis:Corporation a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Issuer .
fis:Bank a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Issuer .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:SovereignGovernment fis:MunicipalGovernment fis:SupranationalOrganization fis:Corporation fis:Bank ) ] .

fis:Holder a owl:Class ; rdfs:comment "An investor entitled to rights under a security." .
fis:Shareholder a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Holder ; rdfs:label "stockholder" .
fis:Bondholder a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Holder .

#################################################################
# 4. DEBT SECURITY cross-cutting dimensions
#################################################################

fis:Collateral a owl:Class ; rdfs:comment "An asset pledged to secure a debt obligation." .
fis:Mortgage a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Collateral .
fis:ResidentialMortgage a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Mortgage .
fis:CommercialMortgage a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Mortgage .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:ResidentialMortgage fis:CommercialMortgage ) ] .
fis:DebtObligationPool a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Collateral ;
  rdfs:comment "A pool of debt obligations (loans, bonds, or other asset-backed securities) pledged as collateral, as in a CDO." .

fis:SecuredDebtSecurity a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:DebtSecurity
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasCollateral ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:Collateral ] ) ] .
fis:UnsecuredDebtSecurity a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:DebtSecurity
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasCollateral ; owl:cardinality 0 ] ) ] .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:SecuredDebtSecurity fis:UnsecuredDebtSecurity ) ] .

fis:PriorityRank a owl:Class .
fis:SeniorRank a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:PriorityRank .
fis:SubordinatedRank a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:PriorityRank .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:SeniorRank fis:SubordinatedRank ) ] .

fis:SeniorDebtSecurity a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:DebtSecurity
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasPriorityRank ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:SeniorRank ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "Debt contractually senior to other unsecured debt; priority in bankruptcy." .
fis:SubordinatedDebtSecurity a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:DebtSecurity
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasPriorityRank ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:SubordinatedRank ] ) ] .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:SeniorDebtSecurity fis:SubordinatedDebtSecurity ) ] .

fis:CreditRating a owl:Class .
fis:InvestmentGrade a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:CreditRating .
fis:HighYield a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:CreditRating ; rdfs:label "junk" .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:InvestmentGrade fis:HighYield ) ] .

#################################################################
# 5. BOND and MONEY MARKET INSTRUMENT
#################################################################

fis:Bond a owl:Class ;
  owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:DebtSecurity
      [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:isNegotiable ; owl:hasValue true ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "A negotiable debt security under which the issuer owes the holder a debt and must pay interest (coupon) and repay principal at maturity." .

fis:MoneyMarketInstrument a owl:Class ;
  rdfs:subClassOf fis:DebtSecurity ;
  rdfs:comment "A short-term debt instrument with original maturity of one year or less; distinguished from a bond by the corpus ('debt securities with a term of less than one year are generally designated money market instruments rather than bonds')." .
fis:Bond owl:disjointWith fis:MoneyMarketInstrument .

fis:TreasuryBill a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:MoneyMarketInstrument
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasIssuer ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:SovereignGovernment ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "A zero-coupon money market instrument issued by a national government, maturing in one year or less." .
fis:CertificateOfDeposit a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:MoneyMarketInstrument
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasIssuer ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:Bank ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:label "CD" ; rdfs:comment "A time deposit sold by banks, thrift institutions, and credit unions." .
fis:CommercialPaper a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:MoneyMarketInstrument fis:UnsecuredDebtSecurity ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "An unsecured promissory note with fixed maturity usually less than 270 days." .
fis:BankersAcceptance a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:MoneyMarketInstrument .
fis:RepurchaseAgreement a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:CashInstrument ;
  rdfs:comment "Borrowing money by combining the sale of a security with its subsequent repurchase at a slightly higher price; the corpus notes that it 'defies categorization' into the cash/derivative matrix cleanly." .

fis:EurodebtSecurity a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:DebtSecurity
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:isIssuedOutsideDomesticMarket ; owl:hasValue true ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "A security issued internationally outside its domestic market in a denomination different from the issuer's domicile." .
fis:Eurobond a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:EurodebtSecurity .
fis:Euronote a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:EurodebtSecurity .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:Eurobond fis:Euronote ) ] .

#################################################################
# 5a. Bond by issuer
#################################################################

fis:GovernmentBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "sovereign bond" ; rdfs:label "treasury bond" ; rdfs:label "gilt" ;
  owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond
      [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasIssuer ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:SovereignGovernment ] ) ] .
fis:SupranationalBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "supra" ;
  owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond
      [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasIssuer ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:SupranationalOrganization ] ) ] .
fis:MunicipalBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "muni" ;
  owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond
      [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasIssuer ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:MunicipalGovernment ] ) ] .
fis:CorporateBond a owl:Class ;
  owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond
      [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasIssuer ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:Corporation ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "Strictly, issued by a corporation; the term is sometimes loosely extended to supranational issuers but excludes municipal bonds." .

owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:GovernmentBond fis:SupranationalBond fis:MunicipalBond fis:CorporateBond ) ] .

fis:TreasuryNote a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:GovernmentBond fis:MediumTermBond ) ] .
fis:TreasuryBond a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:GovernmentBond fis:LongTermBond ) ] .

fis:RepaymentSourceType a owl:Class .
fis:GeneralTaxingPower a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:RepaymentSourceType .
fis:SpecificRevenueStream a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:RepaymentSourceType .
fis:PropertyAssessment a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:RepaymentSourceType .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:GeneralTaxingPower fis:SpecificRevenueStream fis:PropertyAssessment ) ] .

fis:GeneralObligationBond a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:MunicipalBond
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasRepaymentSource ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:GeneralTaxingPower ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "Principal and interest secured by the full faith and credit of the issuer." .
fis:RevenueBond a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:MunicipalBond
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasRepaymentSource ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:SpecificRevenueStream ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "Repayment promised solely from revenues generated by a specified revenue-generating entity; typically non-recourse." .
fis:AssessmentBond a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:MunicipalBond
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasRepaymentSource ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:PropertyAssessment ] ) ] .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:GeneralObligationBond fis:RevenueBond fis:AssessmentBond ) ] .

fis:InvestmentGradeBond a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:CorporateBond
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasCreditRating ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:InvestmentGrade ] ) ] .
fis:HighYieldBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "junk bond" ;
  owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:CorporateBond
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasCreditRating ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:HighYield ] ) ] .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:InvestmentGradeBond fis:HighYieldBond ) ] .

fis:WarBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:GovernmentBond ; rdfs:comment "Issued by a government to fund military operations and wartime expenditure." .
fis:ClimateBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Bond ; rdfs:comment "Issued to raise finance for climate-change mitigation or adaptation projects." .
fis:SocialImpactBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Bond ;
  rdfs:comment "Public sector entities repay private investors after verified social outcome goals are met." .

#################################################################
# 5b. Bond by maturity
#################################################################

fis:ShortTermBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Bond ; rdfs:label "short bond" .
fis:MediumTermBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Bond ; rdfs:label "medium bond" .
fis:LongTermBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Bond ; rdfs:label "long bond" .
fis:PerpetualBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Bond ; rdfs:label "perpetuity" ; rdfs:label "irredeemable bond" ;
  rdfs:comment "A bond with no maturity date." .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:ShortTermBond fis:MediumTermBond fis:LongTermBond fis:PerpetualBond ) ] .

fis:MethuselahBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:LongTermBond ; rdfs:label "Methuselah" ;
  rdfs:comment "A bond with a maturity of 50 years or longer." .
fis:SerialBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Bond ; rdfs:comment "A bond that matures in installments over a period of time." .
fis:LotteryBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Bond ; rdfs:comment "Issuer redeems randomly selected bonds within the issue according to a schedule." .
fis:ForeignCurrencyBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Bond ; rdfs:comment "A bond denominated in a currency other than the issuer's domestic currency." .

#################################################################
# 5c. Bond by coupon type
#################################################################

fis:CouponType a owl:Class .
fis:FixedCoupon a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:CouponType .
fis:FloatingCoupon a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:CouponType .
fis:ZeroCoupon a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:CouponType .
fis:IndexedCoupon a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:CouponType .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:FixedCoupon fis:FloatingCoupon fis:ZeroCoupon fis:IndexedCoupon ) ] .

fis:FixedRateBond a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasCouponType ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:FixedCoupon ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "Coupon remains constant throughout the life of the bond." .
fis:FloatingRateNote a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "floater" ;
  owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasCouponType ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:FloatingCoupon ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "Coupon varies, linked to a reference rate such as LIBOR, Euribor or SOFR." .
fis:ZeroCouponBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "discount bond" ; rdfs:label "deep discount bond" ;
  owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasCouponType ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:ZeroCoupon ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "Pays no periodic interest; issued at a substantial discount to par, with the full face value paid at maturity." .
fis:InflationIndexedBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "linker" ; rdfs:label "index-linked bond" ;
  owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasCouponType ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:IndexedCoupon ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "Principal and interest payments indexed to the level of consumer prices." .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:FixedRateBond fis:FloatingRateNote fis:ZeroCouponBond fis:InflationIndexedBond ) ] .

#################################################################
# 5d. Bond by embedded option
#################################################################

fis:EmbeddedOption a owl:Class .
fis:CallProvision a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:EmbeddedOption .
fis:PutProvision a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:EmbeddedOption .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:CallProvision fis:PutProvision ) ] .

fis:CallableBond a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasEmbeddedOption ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:CallProvision ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "Gives the issuer the right to repay the bond before the maturity date." .
fis:PutableBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "retractable bond" ;
  owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasEmbeddedOption ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:PutProvision ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "Gives the holder the right to force the issuer to repay the bond before maturity." .
fis:BulletBond a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasEmbeddedOption ; owl:cardinality 0 ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "A straight bond that is neither callable nor putable." .

fis:ConvertibleBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "convertible note" ; rdfs:label "convertible debenture" ; rdfs:label "convertible" ;
  rdfs:subClassOf fis:HybridSecurity ;
  owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasConversionTarget ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:CommonStock ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "A bond the holder can convert into a specified number of the issuer's own common shares." .
fis:MandatoryConvertibleBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:ConvertibleBond ; rdfs:comment "Forces conversion into shares at maturity." .
fis:ContingentConvertibleBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "CoCo" ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:ConvertibleBond ;
  rdfs:comment "Automatically converts into equity if a pre-specified trigger event occurs." .
fis:ExchangeableBond a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf fis:Bond ;
  rdfs:comment "Allows exchange into shares of a corporation other than the issuer (distinguishing it from a ConvertibleBond, which converts into the issuer's own shares)." .

#################################################################
# 5e. Bond by ownership record
#################################################################

fis:BearerBond a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond fis:BearerSecurity ) ] .
fis:RegisteredBond a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond fis:RegisteredSecurity ) ] .
fis:BookEntryBond a owl:Class ; owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond fis:BookEntrySecurity ) ] .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:BearerBond fis:RegisteredBond fis:BookEntryBond ) ] .

#################################################################
# 5f. Bond by security/collateral - Debenture, CoveredBond, AssetBackedSecurity
#################################################################

fis:Debenture a owl:Class ;
  owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond fis:UnsecuredDebtSecurity ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "Unsecured bonds are called debentures (corporate-bond usage). CONFLICT: an earlier passage uses 'debenture' more loosely as one of several generic labels for debt securities (debenture, bond, deposit, note, commercial paper) regardless of security; this ontology follows the more precise, majority usage." .

fis:AssetBackedSecurity a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "ABS" ;
  owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond fis:SecuredDebtSecurity
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:remainsOnIssuerBalanceSheet ; owl:hasValue false ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "Bonds whose interest and principal payments are backed by underlying cash flows from a pool of other assets; assets are removed from the issuer's balance sheet (distinguishing it from a CoveredBond)." .

fis:CoveredBond a owl:Class ;
  owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:Bond fis:SecuredDebtSecurity
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:remainsOnIssuerBalanceSheet ; owl:hasValue true ] ) ] ;
  rdfs:comment "Backed by cash flows from mortgages or public sector assets, but unlike ABS, those assets remain on the issuer's balance sheet." .
owl:AllDisjointClasses [ owl:members ( fis:AssetBackedSecurity fis:CoveredBond ) ] .

fis:MortgageBackedSecurity a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "MBS" ;
  owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( fis:AssetBackedSecurity
    [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty fis:hasCollateral ; owl:someValuesFrom fis:Mortgage ] ) ] .
fis:ResidentialMortgageBackedSecurity a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "RMBS" ;

fis:CashFlowComponent a owl:Class .

#################################################################

fis:Stock a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "capital stock" ; rdfs:label "shares" ;

fis:TransactionRight a owl:Class .
```
